name: AhaKey Bridge
description: Mirrors Orca agent status onto the AhaKey X1 light bar: blue sweep while working, red flash when an agent needs you, cyan siren when done.

cover.alt: An AhaKey X1 macro keyboard on a dark desk, its LED light bar glowing blue in a Knight Rider sweep

settings.title: Keyboard screen text
settings.description: Text shown on the X1's little screen. Uploads once when changed (takes a few seconds — the device shows 'Uploading pic'). Leave empty to leave the screen alone.
